name: Tecnólisis
source:
This story is about four prisoners forced to accept a deal in order to recover their freedom. They need to recover a bioweapon developed by the megacorporation that abducted them—or they will die when the facility self-destructs.

[from [url=https://rayala.itch.io/technolysis]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述四名囚犯为重获自由而被迫接受一桩交易：他们必须寻回绑架他们的巨型企业所研发的生化武器——否则一旦设施启动自毁程序，他们都将葬身于此。

[摘自[url=https://rayala.itch.io/technolysis]itch.io[/url]]
